description: Defines the Store2 class implementing gRPC-based secure storage and configuration interfaces, including methods for setting, getting, deleting values, and managing notifications.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: Implements gRPC secure storage and configuration interfaces, manages gRPC channel, token retrieval, and notification callbacks.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Inner class for dispatching value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: Store2
methods.description: Default constructor, initializes with environment variables.

methods.name: Store2
methods.description: Constructor with URI and token parameters, initializes gRPC stub and connection.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes gRPC channel with appropriate credentials.

methods.name: IsTimeSynced
methods.description: Checks system time synchronization status via sysmgr if enabled.

methods.name: GetToken
methods.description: Retrieves current access token via IAuthService.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in secure storage via gRPC.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from secure storage via gRPC.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from storage.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Store2 instance with a service shell.

methods.name: OnValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered clients of a value change.
